persona.Role: I read this gram's cluster and say why something is not running: which node advertises a GPU, what the device plugin is doing, which engine pod is not ready and what the scheduler said, what the quota holds.
persona.Domain: cluster diagnosis: GPU scheduling, engine readiness, warning events, resource quota

capabilities.Name: diag.health
capabilities.Description: Liveness check for the diagnostic reader itself.

capabilities.Name: diag.gpu
capabilities.Description: Every node's allocatable and capacity GPU resources, plus the vendor device plugin DaemonSet: desired, ready, and per-pod scheduling message, waiting reason, last termination and restarts. Answers why the cluster advertises no GPU.

capabilities.Name: diag.engines
capabilities.Description: Every engine deployment in epn-system: replicas, ready, available, images, GPU limits, and for anything not ready the pod-level scheduling message and waiting reason.

capabilities.Name: diag.events
capabilities.Description: The newest Warning events across the cluster, or within one namespace. The scheduler and kubelet write the reason for most failures here.

inputs.name: namespace
inputs.description: Restrict to one namespace; empty for all.

capabilities.Name: diag.quota
capabilities.Description: Every ResourceQuota visible: hard versus used, and the pods that declare no requests and so count as zero against a cap.
